brevity

BREV-i-tee · noun

Hear It

What It Means

Brevity is concise and exact use of words; shortness.

The coach's postgame speech was remembered for its brevity: just four words, and every player understood exactly what he meant.

Example

Old telegrams charged senders by the word, which forced people to master brevity, packing an entire message into a single crisp line.

Brevity is about saying exactly what's needed and nothing more -- not just being short, but being efficiently short.

Compare the words

Synonyms · words with a similar meaning

conciseness: Conciseness is trimming your wording so every sentence pulls its weight -- nothing missing, nothing wasted. Brevity is plain shortness. A concise history may still run five hundred pages because all of them are needed; brevity would simply make it shorter. Brevity measures length; conciseness measures efficiency.

succinctness: Succinctness is packing a full idea into a few well-chosen words -- it describes wording and nothing else. Brevity is broader: anything can have it if it is short. A late-night study session can have brevity, but only its wording can have succinctness.

What it isn’t · antonyms and near-opposites

verbosity: the use of far more words than necessary

wordiness: the quality of using too many words

Where it sits · how compressed the wording is

directness → brevity → terseness

directness vs. brevity: Directness just means getting straight to the point without detours; a direct answer can still run long, while brevity actually keeps things short.

terseness vs. brevity: Terseness pushes brevity even further, often to the point of sounding blunt or curt.

Build the Word

The pieces

root — brev-: short (Latin brevis)

suffix — -ity: state of, quality of (Latin/French)

Put it together: Brevity comes directly from Latin brevis ('short'), the very same root that gives English the everyday word brief, plus -ity ('state of') -- 'the state of being short.'

Use the root in a new word: brief: The team abbreviated its long official name on the new road jerseys.

Word Choice

Brevity is almost always a compliment when applied to writing or speech -- it praises saying exactly what's needed without wasted words.
